subject: adjustment of factor labels containing expressions

messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: adjustment of factor labels containing expressions
parts:
Hi,

here's another problem, that I encountered recently. I noticed that
factor labels get right-adjusted, if an expression is used as label-
names. Here's an example:

lab<-c(expression(paste('Placebo (n=104)')),expression(paste('45
',mu,'g/kg (n=8)')),expression(paste('115-125 ',mu,'g/kg (n=72)')))

p<-ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl),fill=factor(cyl))) +geom_bar()
p+scale_fill_hue(labels=lab)

Is there an easy way to get the labels left-adjusted?

Kind regards,

Erich
